items.summary: French presidential candidate David Lisnard has surprised many by surpassing former prime ministers Edouard Philippe and Gabriel Attal in a recent voter intention pole. The mayor of Cannes is running on an ultra-liberal platform and has gained a large following on social media, but some critics say he lacks the national experience needed for the Elysée.

items.title: Jensen Huang returns as NVIDIA CEO after intelligence scandal
items.summary: Jensen Huang is reinstated as NVIDIA’s CEO after reports he was targeted in an alleged foreign intelligence operation.
